title: 棱边静态侧拉
description: 赛璐璐风格以低侧拉点和踏点描绘绕棱时的稳定身体线。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: Create an original cel-animation illustration of a fictional adult using a broad low sidepull beside a rounded arete. One hand naturally grips the hold on the near face, the other rests on a large jug around the edge, and both feet remain on clearly drawn positive footholds close to the crash mat. The hips shift slightly toward the supporting shoe as the torso faces the corner of the wall. Use a medium-wide oblique camera showing the whole opaque-clothed figure, both faces, and continuous thick padding. Crisp indigo outlines and warm coral shapes create an original scene. Exclude text, brands, jumps, dangerous exposure, and forced flexibility.
